title: Shopping cart total
hints: Start with the interface: list each property with its type, e.g. `name: string;`.
`items.reduce((sum, item) => ..., 0)` walks the cart and carries a running total. Each line is worth `priceCents * quantity`.
For formatting: `(cents / 100).toFixed(2)` gives "12.50" — just put a `$` in front.
